# /handoff-to-garrett - pass your lane to Garrett

Read `.claude/skills/swimlanes/HANDOFF.md` first; it is the whole procedure. In short:

1. Find the lane: the one you name, else the lane this branch's change is most about (the tool reads the diff).
2. Write the handoff, with a note that says where the work stands and what Garrett does next:

```bash
python3 Tools/Build/handoff.py to Garrett --note "<where it stands; what to do next; what is untested>"
```

   Add `--lane <key>` when the branch spans several lanes or you hand a lane you did not touch.
3. Commit `Docs/Handoffs/` on this branch and push it (`docs(handoff): <lane> to Garrett`), so it lands with the work.
4. Tell your person in one line that Garrett sees it as NEW on `/swimlanes` and the Swim Lanes page, and offer to sync the
   page (`/swimlanes` section 6).
